weaknesses.title: LEFTF/TRUNCF glue steals N/WIDTH/TO/LEN/BY vars
weaknesses.detail: Optional glue before length expr: TO|OF|LEN|WIDTH|N|BY. LEFTF s token N or LEFTF s token WIDTH consumes the var name as glue then fails LEFTF object field n. Must use non-glue names (KLEN).
weaknesses.repro: LEFTF s0 token N → parse fail; LEFTF s0 token WIDTH → parse fail; KLEN works

weaknesses.title: LEFTF/TRUNCF promote numeric fields to string
weaknesses.detail: Same poison class as CATF; digit peel leaves string field.

weaknesses.title: CLEARF has no selective secret policy / audit trail
weaknesses.detail: Wipe is silent; agents must journal separately. No CLEARF WHERE fleet wipe.

weaknesses.title: FINDF empty needle → index 0 always
weaknesses.detail: Same empty-needle class as HASINF; peel with empty NEEDLE peels whole string from 0+1.

weaknesses.title: EQF case-sensitive by default — need EQFI for status Open/open
weaknesses.detail: Easy gate miss if mixed case from intake.

weaknesses.title: DEFAULTF treats blank whitespace as empty
weaknesses.detail: Fill triggers on "   "; may surprise if intentional pad.
